answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 2757 Country: India Title: Is it lawful to use cell phone in masjid while namaz is not offered (like in Etikaaf) as I have seen so many people using there cell phones in masjid? Question: Is it lawful to use cell phone in masjid while namaz is not offered (like in Etikaaf) as I have seen so many people using there cell phones in masjid? Answer ID: 2757 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 70/70=L) One can have worldly or religious talks only as much as necessary by mobile phone in a state of Etikaf (secluding oneself in mosque with the intention of worship): وتکلم الا بخیر وھو ما لا اثم فیہ ومنہ المباح عند الحاجۃ الیہ لا عند عدمھا۔ ( الدر المختار مع الشامی: 3/441، ط زکریا دیوبند ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
